name: Tensei Shita Koukousei wa Jitsuwa OO desu...
original_name: 転生した高校生は実はOOです。。。
source:
After an accident, you become reincarnated as an adventurer in a fantasy world. You meet various characters and decide if you want to let them into your party. Your choices will affect the final outcome of your campaign.

[From [url=https://crying-eggo.itch.io/tensei-shita-kokosei-wa-jitsuwa-xx-desu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场意外后，你转生成了奇幻世界中的冒险者。你将遇见各式各样的角色，决定是否让他们加入队伍。你的选择，将影响这场冒险的最终结果。

[摘自[url=https://crying-eggo.itch.io/tensei-shita-kokosei-wa-jitsuwa-xx-desu]Itch.io[/url]]
